item.title: Downgrade validator agent to MODEL_FAST (sonnet)
item.intent: Validation costs 5x less without quality loss — validators do read-only verification, not code generation, so opus is dramatically overqualified.
item.description: The validator agent currently runs on MODEL_PRIMARY (opus). Validators read diffs, run AC verify commands, and write a pass/fail verdict. This is read-only analytical work that sonnet handles well. Change the validator invocation in _run_validation_cycle() to use MODEL_FAST instead of MODEL_PRIMARY.
steps: In _run_validation_cycle(), change the run_agent call for validator from MODEL_PRIMARY to MODEL_FAST
Update docs/CONFIGURATION.md if it references which model the validator uses

acceptanceCriteria.text: Validator agent is invoked with MODEL_FAST model
No other agent invocations are changed — developer still uses MODEL_PRIMARY
